tasks.title: Add the Claude Code adapter
tasks.objective: Create src/agents/claude.ts exporting a pure Claude adapter that builds print-mode arguments and extracts the final message from Claude's JSON stdout.
out_of_scope: Do not register the adapter (TASK-003).
Do not change session.ts, report.ts or outcomes.ts.
Do not add pre-flight checks or special handling for an unavailable 'auto' permission mode.
Do not use bypassPermissions or any full-access permission mode.
existing_context: src/agents/types.ts and src/agents/codex.ts exist after TASK-001 and define the adapter shape and FinalMessageResult kinds: message, missing, invalid, failed.
The process exit code and signal are handled by the shared session runner, not the adapter; the adapter only sees stdout of a process that exited with code 0.
constraints: Pure functions only; no fs, no process access.
The cwd is set by the session runner via spawn cwd; do not add a cwd flag to Claude's arguments.
implementation_guidelines: Export const claudeAdapter: AgentAdapter with name 'claude' and executable 'claude'.

buildArgs returns ['-p','--output-format','json','--permission-mode','auto', ...(model !== undefined ? ['--model',model] : []), ...(effort !== undefined ? ['--effort',effort] : [])]. The prompt is not an argument because it is sent on stdin.
extractFinalMessage(stdout): if stdout.trim() === '' return { kind: 'missing' }.

Then JSON.parse(stdout); on a throw return { kind: 'invalid', reason: 'agent output could not be parsed' }. If the parsed value is not a non-null object (e.g. array, string, null) also return that invalid result.

If the object has is_error === true return { kind: 'failed', reason: <string> } where reason is `Claude reported an error (subtype: ${subtype})` when subtype is a non-empty string, otherwise 'Claude reported an error'.
If result is not a string or result.trim() === '' return { kind: 'missing' }.
Otherwise return { kind: 'message', text: result }.
Add test/agents/claude.test.ts covering every row of the AC-008 table that the adapter can see, plus buildArgs variants.
acceptance_criteria: buildArgs({cwd:'/w'}) equals ['-p','--output-format','json','--permission-mode','auto'] and never contains 'bypassPermissions'.
buildArgs({cwd:'/w',model:'m',effort:'high'}) additionally ends with '--model','m','--effort','high'.
extractFinalMessage('') returns missing; 'not json' returns invalid with reason 'agent output could not be parsed'.
extractFinalMessage('{"is_error":true,"subtype":"error_max_turns","result":"x"}') returns kind 'failed' with a reason containing 'error_max_turns'.
extractFinalMessage('{"result":""}') and extractFinalMessage('{}') return missing.
extractFinalMessage(JSON.stringify({ is_error: false, result: '{"outcome":"complete"}' })) returns kind 'message' with text '{"outcome":"complete"}'.
extractFinalMessage('[]'), extractFinalMessage('null') and extractFinalMessage('"x"') return invalid with reason 'agent output could not be parsed'.
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass.
assumptions: Claude's JSON fields (result, is_error, subtype) are as stated in the spec Assumptions; TASK-015 verifies them against the real CLI.
An is_error: true result is checked before the result field is inspected.

tasks.title: Capture the last 20 lines of agent stderr per session
tasks.objective: Pipe agent stderr in the session runner, keep only its last 20 lines, and attach them to execution-error results.
out_of_scope: Do not print the lines (TASK-007).

constraints: Memory use must be bounded: do not accumulate the whole stderr; keep at most the last 20 complete lines plus the current partial line.
Stderr must not be shown live.
implementation_guidelines: In src/outcomes.ts add `stderrTail?: string[]` to the SessionResult 'execution-error' variant (not to ExecutionError).
In src/session.ts change stdio to ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] and read child.stderr with setEncoding('utf8').

Create a small exported helper in src/stderr-tail.ts: createStderrTail(limit = 20) returning { push(chunk: string): void; lines(): string[] }. It splits on '\n' (strip a trailing '\r'), carries the partial last line across chunks, keeps only the last `limit` lines, and lines() includes a non-empty trailing partial line. Empty lines inside the output are kept; a final empty remainder is not counted as a line.

Attach `stderrTail: tail.lines()` to every execution-error result produced after the process closed (non-zero exit, signal, missing, invalid, failed), and for launch-failed too (it will be []). The field is always an array on execution-error results ([] when nothing was written). timed-out, interrupted and response results never carry the field.
Add test/stderr-tail.test.ts and extend the fixture (test/fixtures/fake-codex.mjs) with `step.stderr` (string written to process.stderr before exit).
acceptance_criteria: createStderrTail: pushing 25 lines 'l1'..'l25' yields lines() equal to 'l6'..'l25'.
createStderrTail: a line split across two push calls ('ab' then 'c\n') yields ['abc'].
A session whose fixture writes stderr 'boom\n' and exits 3 returns execution-error with stderrTail ['boom'].
A session whose fixture writes no stderr and exits 3 returns execution-error with stderrTail [].
A session ending with a valid protocol response, a timeout or an interruption has no stderrTail property on its result.
Fixture stderr is not written to the test process's stderr.
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass.
assumptions: Lines are split on '\n' only; ANSI sequences are left as is.
